title: 第5897章 赔你剑第5896章 精准伏击
slug: 天域丹尊第5904章不堪一击
content_zh:
苏尘心中狐疑，自己还有这样的记忆？
难道这就是仓沙所说的觉醒？但为什么又会和烬扯上关系？
一幅幅画面在苏尘脑海中飞速闪过，他看到一头形态诡异的生灵，身躯庞大到难以形容，周身长满触手，正趴在一个位面上，拼命想要挤入其中，却始终无法成功。
这般对比之下清晰可见，这生灵的身躯大小堪比一个位面，甚至还要更庞大一些。
什么样的生灵能庞大到如此地步？
苏尘心中浮现出一个名字——烬。
肯定是它了，在见过烬的人描述之中，它的身形堪比位面，能吞噬世间万物。
难道这就是它与万象位面对峙的真实场景？
苏尘内心疑虑，没想通自己怎么会存有这样的记忆，而且还被烬的力量所激发出来。
烬每次都能在混沌中精准找到自己，迅速来袭，难道也与此有关？
还有！
苏尘突然一怔，这几次烬虽然来势汹汹，却显然没有置自己于死地的打算。
似乎，它的出手只是想唤醒自己体内埋藏的这段记忆。
烬究竟想干什么，三番五次伏击自己，难道仅仅只是为了让自己看到这些画面？
不，还有一股难以形容的邪恶意念，仿佛要唤醒自己体内被压抑的某种念头。
轰隆隆，脑海中的画面不断变幻，那庞大的生灵与某个位面对峙许久，位面中更有无数强者奋力抵抗，竭力阻挡这尊巨大生灵的入侵。
这些人，全都是合道境。
苏尘知道，这是烬在与万象位面的强者大战。
画面继续变动，烬对这个位面久攻不下，身躯一震，数百道光点从它庞大的躯体之中涌出，在混沌中飞速穿梭。
画面一转，紧紧追随着这些光点前行。有的光点遭遇混沌风暴，很快湮灭消散，也有部分光点穿过无尽混沌，降临到了其他位面。

镜头牢牢锁定其中一颗光点，随它进入一个低阶位面。
这时，苏尘生出无比强烈的熟悉感。
他看着那处光点并未停留，径直穿过那个位面的一个又一个区域，最终闯入一处小世界，咻的一声，没入了一名身怀六甲的女子体内。
这女子……苏尘非常熟悉，因为她分明就是自己的娘亲！
苏尘生出一股荒谬感，看着这女子生下一个男婴，正是自己，男婴长到十五岁，拜入了正一宗，后来又离开宗门，开启了自己精彩而沉浮的一世。
整个过程中，那道光点始终未曾熄灭过，但也从来没有浮出水面过。
苏尘身躯一震，猛的回过神来，脑海中的画面尽数消散。
体内无数位面之力同时爆发，硬生生将烬侵入的那道邪恶意志彻底磨灭。
“嗡！”
他的真元海泛起灵光，一枚合道之符缓缓浮现，瞬间将真元海中的其他合道之符压制得黯淡无光。
这竟是一枚一流合道之符！
苏尘一时间抓不住头绪，信息量实在太庞大了。
他强行让自己冷静下来，开始一点点梳理。
content_en:
Su Chen was suspicious, did he still have such a memory?
Is this what Cang Sha calls awakening? But why is it related to Jhin again?
A picture flashed through Su Chen's mind. He saw a strange creature with a body that was indescribably huge and covered with tentacles. It was lying on a plane, trying desperately to squeeze into it, but could not succeed.
From this comparison, it is clearly visible that the body size of this creature is comparable to a plane, or even larger.
What kind of creature can be so huge?
A name emerged in Su Chen's mind—Jin.
It must be it. According to the descriptions of people who have seen Jhin, its shape is comparable to a plane and it can swallow everything in the world.
Could this be the real scene of its confrontation with the Vientiane Plane?
Su Chen had doubts in his heart, wondering how he could have such a memory and be inspired by Jhin's power.
Jhin can accurately find himself in the chaos every time and attack quickly. Could it be related to this?
besides!
Su Chen was suddenly startled. Although Jin had been aggressive these times, he obviously had no intention of killing himself.
It seems that its action is just to awaken this memory buried in its body.
What exactly does Jhin want to do? Is it just to let him see these scenes by ambushing him again and again?
No, there is also an indescribable evil thought, which seems to awaken some suppressed thoughts in his body.
Rumbling, the picture in his mind kept changing. The huge creature had been confronting a certain plane for a long time. There were countless strong people in the plane struggling to resist, trying their best to stop the invasion of this huge creature.
These people are all in the Hedao realm.
Su Chen knew that this was a battle between Jin and the powerful in the Wanxiang plane.
The screen continued to change. Jhin was unable to attack this plane for a long time, and his body shook. Hundreds of light points poured out from its huge body and shuttled rapidly through the chaos.
The screen turned and followed these light spots closely. Some light points encountered the storm of chaos and were quickly annihilated and dissipated, while some light points passed through the endless chaos and descended to other planes.
The lens firmly locks on one of the light spots and follows it into a lower-level plane.
At this time, Su Chen felt an extremely strong sense of familiarity.
He looked at the light spot and did not stop. It went straight through one area after another on that plane, and finally broke into a small world, and with a whoosh, sank into the body of a pregnant woman.
This woman... Su Chen was very familiar with her, because she was clearly his mother!
Su Chen felt a sense of absurdity as he watched the woman give birth to a baby boy, who was himself. The baby boy grew up to be fifteen years old and joined the Zhengyi sect. Later, he left the sect and started his own wonderful and ups and downs life.
During the whole process, the light spot never went out, but it never surfaced.
Su Chen's body trembled and he suddenly came back to his senses. All the images in his mind disappeared.
The power of countless planes in the body exploded at the same time, forcibly destroying the evil will that invaded Jin.
"Buzz!"
His True Essence Sea glowed with aura, and a Hedao Talisman slowly emerged, instantly suppressing the other Hedao Talismans in the True Essence Sea and dimming them.
This is actually a first-class Hedao Talisman!
Su Chen couldn't grasp the clue for a while, the amount of information was too huge.
He forced himself to calm down and started combing bit by bit.
